method: freshly-loaded records (Last Modified within 3d of as-of); load_lag = last_modified - newest_action_date
interpretation: Civilian-agency obligations post near-real-time (median 0d, 85% within 7d) and are NOT press-released -> ideal frontrun substrate. Sub-threshold DEFENSE (esp. DLA SPE* logistics) posts on a ~quarterly batch (median ~98d) -> obscure but too stale to frontrun the next print. The two legs of the spec's Arm-A 'civilian AND/OR sub-7.5M-defense' definition have OPPOSITE latency.
